At 3:01 you're comparing a traditional SPINNING DISK hard drive (2.5" external) with a 4TB SSD (essentially a block of non-volatile memory) - they are very different technologies - SSDs are much, much faster and cost a lot more than traditional spinning disk HDDs.

What is increasing in price is RAM - and an SSD uses RAM whereas a traditional HDD uses a spinning magnetic disk. All memory comes from a handful of companies and they have all abandoned consumers in favour of the much more lucrative AI market. Some types of RAM have increased as much as 4x in price and this is not going to change for at least a couple of years.
